guide.title: Reporting Tutorial
guide.subtitle: Learn how to write actionable grievances, add clean evidence, choose the right privacy mode, and test the AI triage simulator.

step1.title: Select Issue
step1.heading: Step 1: Choose the Most Specific Category
step1.desc: Routing your ticket to the right maintenance engineers starts with precise categorization.

examples.water: No running water, leaking main pipelines, broken bathroom cisterns, contaminated tank supply.
examples.electricity: Blown fuses, flickering corridor lights, non-functioning ceiling fans, exposed wires.
examples.infrastructure: Cracked stairs, broken window glass, unhinged doors, damaged classroom benches.
examples.sanitation: Overflowing dustbins, uncleaned washrooms, blocked drainage canals, stagnant rainwater.
examples.safety: Dark campus stretches, missing manhole covers, stray animal menace, emergency hazards.
examples.academic: Broken laboratory equipment, faulty projectors, non-functioning departmental printers.
examples.administrative: Pending certificate verification, hostel room allocation disputes, library card issues.
examples.other: General civic and campus maintenance queries not covered by standard branches.

step2.title: Describe Problem
step2.heading: Step 2: Write with Specificity and Context
step2.desc: Vague reports require back-and-forth clarification. Detailed descriptions allow technicians to bring exact replacement parts on their first visit.

step3.title: Add Evidence
step3.heading: Step 3: Capture Clean, Focused Evidence
step3.desc: Photos help staff diagnose problems remotely. Adhere strictly to institutional data minimization guidelines.

step4.title: Privacy Options
step4.heading: Step 4: Understand Public vs Private vs Anonymous
step4.desc: Choose who gets to see your report based on the sensitivity of the issue.

step5.title: Practice Simulator
step5.heading: Step 5: Test the Interactive AI Simulator
step5.desc: Experiment with different descriptions and see how CivicSense categorizes, estimates SLAs, and flags duplicates without affecting live campus numbers.
